# Conflict Rule 7 ## The Underground is a faction
[italic][color=#b8860b]The Underground Black Market is a neutral faction led by the Godfather. The TSF pays a bounty for its people, and the PDV marks some of them as heretics.[/color][/italic]
- [color=#d93c3c][bold]Being Underground is not a reason to attack.[/bold][/color] You need an RP reason and escalation, like in any other conflict. -- Its dealings with the Reavers are not a reason either.
- [bold]Wanted means alive.[/bold] The TSF bounty on a Fugitive or the Godfather is paid for a live prisoner. Make a [textlink="clear demand" link="MonolithRuleConflictThreeFairPlay"] and give them [color=#b8860b][bold]10 seconds[/bold][/color]. -- Use force if they refuse or run. Use lethal force only if they fight back. -- You can disable a ship that runs. Don't destroy it or kill its crew unless they shoot back. -- The one exception is a strike on the station that admins have allowed. Its defenders can be killed like any outpost's.
- [bold]Offer bail.[/bold] Before you turn a prisoner in, tell the Underground you have them and wait [color=#b8860b][bold]5 minutes[/bold][/color]. If they pay your price, let the prisoner go. -- Your price can't be more than [color=#b8860b][bold]30,000 thalers[/bold][/color] for a Fugitive or [color=#b8860b][bold]80,000 thalers[/bold][/color] for the Godfather.
- [bold]One capture per hour.[/bold] After an Underground member is turned in, bailed out or killed, leave that player alone for [color=#b8860b][bold]1 hour[/bold][/color]. -- This ends if they attack you.
- [bold]The Underground station is a faction outpost.[/bold] It falls under [textlink="Conflict Rule 4" link="MonolithRuleConflictFourPortStriking"], but the war level never opens it. Striking it needs [color=#b8860b]admin permission[/color]. -- Going aboard to make a capture is a strike. Catch them out in the sector. -- Don't camp its cryo and spawn rooms.
- [bold]Market truce.[/bold] Any ship the Underground has invited to dock is a guest, TSF and PDV ships included. Guests and the Underground don't attack each other while the ship is there. -- If a guest breaks the truce, the Underground can declare a vendetta on the radio and attack that crew without further escalation for [color=#b8860b][bold]30 minutes[/bold][/color].
- [bold]The Underground is for hire.[/bold] Anyone can hire it for smuggling, theft, extraction, information and sabotage of ships, even while the war level is COLD. -- It can't be hired to kill faction members or to strike an outpost (see [textlink="Conflict Rule 5" link="WGRuleConflictFiveDeclaringWar"]).
- [bold]The Godfather leads.[/bold] Fugitives answer to the Godfather, who falls under the [textlink="commander rule" link="MonolithRuleRoleplayNineCommandingRoles"]. -- Don't give away or sell the station's position, and don't hand your own people in for the bounty. That is [textlink="role abandonment" link="MonolithRuleRoleplayEightFactionRoles"].
- [bold]Marked heretics.[/bold] An Underground member the PDV has marked is covered by the heretic lines in [textlink="Conflict Rule 1" link="MonolithRuleConflictOneRandomDeathmatch"].
